### Triage data subject requests

Prioritizes privacy requests using identity, deadline, sensitivity, third-party, and legal-hold signals.

**Production gate:** this inactive template uses an unauthenticated webhook for local testing only. Configure built-in webhook authentication, review policy version 1.0.1, and assign a human owner before activation.
